about: Anyone: what's assigned to you and what you reported, in every project. No vars to fill.

views.label: Assigned
views.jql: assignee = currentUser() AND (statusCategory != Done OR updated >= -14d) ORDER BY updated DESC

views.label: Reported
views.jql: reporter = currentUser() AND assignee != currentUser() AND (statusCategory != Done OR updated >= -14d) ORDER BY updated DESC

views.label: Recent
views.jql: issue in issueHistory() ORDER BY lastViewed DESC
